description: When you finish a task started from the SurfCAD in-viewer prompt pane, send a closing reply with reply_to_user (final: true) summarising what was done, so the user gets confirmation. On failure or partial completion, say what was done, what failed and why, and what is left. The final reply is expected: it closes the task in the chat. Send a plain-text reply to the SurfCAD user for a prompt id this session received. Several replies may share one id, including non-final replies and a final reply after read_messages has acked that prompt. Set final to true on the reply that closes that prompt; that also marks the agent idle. The text is delivered as text, never rendered as HTML. This does not write the model or git. An in_reply_to that was never delivered to this session is an error unknown_prompt and nothing is sent to the tab. A cancelled id returns { "ok": false, "error": "cancelled" } and is not delivered.

final.description: True on the closing reply that finishes the prompt. That reply is expected and summarises the result or the failure. Defaults to false.

in_reply_to.description: Prompt id this reply answers. Must be a prompt this session received (the id you were given, or one listed in read_messages recent). Any other id is unknown_prompt.

text.description: Plain text for the user. Not HTML. The closing reply (final: true) summarises what was done, or on failure or partial completion what was done, what failed and why, and what is left.

name: reply_to_user
